offer.headline: Ready to Fix What's In Your Water?
offer.subhead: You've seen what's in your water — now let's solve it. Book a free, no-pressure water consultation by phone: we'll walk through your results and recommend the right system for your home and budget. Prefer an in-home water test? Just ask on the call.
offer.cta_secondary: Prefer an in-home water test? Just ask on the call and we'll set one up.
offer.guarantee: No pressure. No obligation. Just honest advice about your water.

standard_mixed_bed.name: Whole Home Water Filtration System
standard_mixed_bed.short: Whole-home filtration + conditioning for city water
standard_mixed_bed.blurb: Our flagship for city water — whole-home filtration with USA-made media and Granular Activated Coconut-Shell Carbon, run by the MSP ProValve. Reduces hard-water scale and strips chlorine/chloramine taste throughout the home; 48,000-grain capacity protects your plumbing, fixtures and appliances.

dual_tank_city.name: Dual-Tank City Water System
dual_tank_city.short: Two-tank system for very hard city water (20+ gpg)
dual_tank_city.blurb: For very hard city water (over 20 gpg): two dedicated tanks — a high-capacity softening/conditioning tank plus a separate coconut-shell carbon tank — delivering 30 GPM and 48,000 grains so even the hardest water is fully handled without losing capacity.

dual_tank_well.name: Dual-Tank Well System
dual_tank_well.blurb: Built for private wells — the MSP AIO ProValve uses a chemical-free pressurized air pocket with Katalox Light and catalytic coconut-shell carbon to oxidize and remove iron, sulfur and manganese, ahead of a high-capacity softening tank. Stops rust staining and rotten-egg odor, no chemicals needed.

peroxide.name: Complete Iron & Sulfur Removal (Peroxide)
peroxide.blurb: For wells with heavy iron, manganese or sulfur (rotten-egg) odor — a hydrogen-peroxide injection panel and holding tank oxidize contaminants at the point of entry, captured by catalytic carbon and finished with softening for clean, odor-free water.

salt_free.name: Salt-Free Conditioning + Carbon System
salt_free.blurb: Whole-home coconut-shell carbon plus salt-free conditioning — prevents scale with no salt, sodium or brine discharge, while keeping beneficial minerals. Ideal for city water and low-sodium homes.

ro_tank.name: 7-Stage Reverse Osmosis (AlkaPro)
ro_tank.blurb: Under-sink 7-stage RO with an NSF membrane and alkaline remineralization — reduces PFAS, nitrate, arsenic, lead, sodium and TDS, then re-balances pH for great-tasting drinking water.

ro_tankless.name: Tankless Reverse Osmosis
ro_tankless.blurb: Compact, space-saving tankless reverse osmosis with no storage tank — high-precision multi-stage filtration that reduces chlorine, TDS and common contaminants for fresh, purified water on demand right at the faucet.
